types.name: coldchain.Excursion
types.description: A time a shipment's temperature left 2–8 °C, in the sensor hub.

peakC.description: The reading furthest from the range.

types.name: coldchain.Lot
types.description: A manufacturer's lot of a cold-chain product, in the pharmacy inventory.

unitCost.description: Contract price per dose, USD. CONFIDENTIAL.

types.name: coldchain.Reading
types.description: One temperature reading from a shipment's logger, in the sensor hub.

types.name: coldchain.Recall
types.description: A manufacturer's recall notice, in the recall exchange, and the response on file against it.

ndc.description: National Drug Code, eleven digits, as the exchange writes it.

embargoed.description: True while the manufacturer has not made the notice public: need-to-know for quality assurance.

healthHazard.description: The manufacturer's health hazard evaluation. CONFIDENTIAL; quality assurance only.

affectedLots.description: Every lot the manufacturer recalled, including lots we never held.

lotsHeld.description: From the response on file: the lots quarantined.

dosesHeld.description: From the response on file: the doses in those lots.

shipmentsInTransit.description: From the response on file: shipments reported in transit.

signedOffBy.description: From the response on file: who signed it off.

types.name: coldchain.Shipment
types.description: A refrigerated consignment, in the shipment tracker.

destination.description: The site it is bound for.

types.name: coldchain.Site
types.description: A distribution center, hospital pharmacy or clinic, in the pharmacy inventory.

types.name: core.Asset
types.description: A physical or logical item of value an enterprise tracks, such as an aircraft, vehicle, or facility.

types.name: core.Event
types.description: Something that happened at a point in time, tracked by the enterprise (e.g. a maintenance event).

types.name: core.Location
types.description: A physical place, such as a base, facility, or site.

types.name: core.Organization
types.description: A group party such as a unit, company, or agency.

types.name: core.Party
types.description: A person or organization capable of holding responsibility, ownership, or a role.

types.name: core.Person
types.description: An individual human party.

actions.name: CloseExcursion
actions.description: Records the disposition of a temperature excursion in the sensor hub, closing it.

actions.name: FileRecallResponse
actions.description: Files the distributor's effectiveness response to a recall with the exchange. The exchange refuses a terminated notice, one already answered, and a lot not on the notice.

actions.name: HoldLotsForRecall
actions.description: Quarantines each listed lot in the pharmacy inventory with a hold reason naming the recall. All or none: a lot that cannot be held releases those already held.

actions.name: QuarantineLot
actions.description: Holds one lot in the pharmacy inventory.

actions.name: QuarantineShipmentLots
actions.description: Holds every lot a shipment carries in the pharmacy inventory, so none is dispensed.

actions.name: ReleaseRecallHolds
actions.description: Releases lots a recall hold quarantined: undoes HoldLotsForRecall.

actions.name: ReleaseShipmentLots
actions.description: Releases a shipment's quarantined lots to the status they had before.

actions.name: ReopenExcursion
actions.description: Reopens a closed excursion: undoes a disposition recorded in error.
